title: Hercules
about: The son of Zeus, raised on Earth, trains to become a true hero and win back his place on Olympus.
cue: Serve the feast when the Muses start Zero to Hero.

    StartersWonder Boy's Thebes spanakopitaFilo triangles filled with spinach, feta and dillHow to make it400g spinach200g feta1 tbsp chopped dill3 spring onions, sliced1 egg6 sheets of filo pastry60g butter, meltedWilt the spinach, squeeze dry and chop.Mix with the feta, dill, spring onions and egg.Cut the filo into strips, brush with butter, add a spoon of filling and fold into triangles.Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes.Hydra heads haloumiGriddled haloumi, honey, chilli, thyme. Cut one, get twoHow to make it500g haloumi, in thick slices2 tbsp honey1 tsp chilli flakes1 tsp thyme leaves1 lemonGriddle the haloumi in a hot dry pan for 2 minutes a side until golden.Drizzle with honey, sprinkle with chilli flakes and thyme, and squeeze over lemon.Cook more as fast as it disappears.Phil's lamb keftedes with tzatzikiLamb meatballs, no fur wedgieHow to make itAs written, serves 4Little lamb meatballs with mint, oregano and feta, pan-fried until crusty and served on skewers with cool garlic tzatziki and lemon.Mix 500g lamb mince with 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 40g fresh breadcrumbs, 60g crumbled feta, chopped mint, 1 tsp dried oregano and salt.Roll into 24 balls and fry in olive oil for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.Grate 1 Lebanese cucumber, squeeze dry and mix with 250g Greek yoghurt, 1 grated garlic clove, lemon and dill.Serve the keftedes on skewers with the tzatziki.MainsPhil's training island souvlakiLemon oregano lamb skewers with cucumber garlic yoghurtHow to make it1kg lamb leg, diced2 lemons, juiced4 garlic cloves, 3 for the marinade and 1 for the sauce2 tsp dried oregano4 tbsp extra virgin olive oil300g Greek yoghurt1 Lebanese cucumber, grated4 pita breads2 tomatoes, sliced1 red onion, slicedMarinate the lamb in the lemon juice, garlic, oregano and oil.Leave to marinate for 2 hours.Thread onto skewers and grill hot.Mix the yoghurt with the grated cucumber and garlic.Serve in warm pita with tomato and red onion.Hades's fiery chilli garlic prawnsChilli prawns. Whoa, is my hair out?How to make itAs written, serves 4King prawns baked in a bubbling chilli, garlic and tomato sauce with crumbled feta, served with crusty bread and a lemony orzo.Heat the oven to 200°C.Soften 1 diced onion and 4 sliced garlic cloves in olive oil, add 1 tsp chilli flakes and 1 chopped red chilli, then 1 tin crushed tomatoes and oregano and simmer 10 minutes.Stir in 800g peeled green king prawns, tip into a baking dish, crumble 150g feta over and bake 10 minutes.Cook 300g orzo and toss with lemon zest, butter and parsley.Serve with crusty bread.SweetsAmbrosia loukoumades (honey puffs)Fried yeast dough puffs tossed in warm honey and cinnamonHow to make it250g plain flour7g dried yeast1 pinch salt300ml warm water1 L vegetable oil, for frying150g honey, warmed1 tsp cinnamon60g walnuts, choppedMix the flour, yeast, salt and water to a thick batter.Rest the batter for an hour.Drop spoonfuls into 175°C oil and fry until puffed and golden.Toss in warm honey with cinnamon and scatter over the walnuts.DrinksOlympus golden peach and honey fizzPeach nectar, honey, lemon and orange blossom water over iceHow to make it2 tbsp honey2 tbsp warm water600ml peach nectar1 lemon, juiced1/2 tsp orange blossom water1 ripe peach, sliced500ml chilled sparkling water2 cups ice4 sprigs of mintStir the honey into the warm water until dissolved.In a jug mix the peach nectar, honey water, lemon juice and orange blossom water.Fill glasses with ice and peach slices, pour in the nectar to two thirds and top with sparkling water. Add a mint sprig.Greek frappéPain and Panic, wired on two of these.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
